tickets.title: Set up the folder structure, routing and styles solution
tickets.description: Establish the project skeleton the brief asks for in the initial setup phase: a folder structure, routing configuration with optional NotFound and Error pages, and a styles solution.
acceptance_criteria: The project has a documented folder structure.
Routing is configured, with a basic NotFound and Error page.
A styles solution is in place and used by the first page.

tickets.title: Add formatters, linters, an error boundary and GitHub Actions
tickets.description: Add the optional quality tooling from the initial setup phase: formatters and linters, an error boundary, and GitHub Actions running the checks.
acceptance_criteria: Formatters and linters run on the codebase.
An error boundary catches render errors.
GitHub Actions run the checks on every push.

tickets.title: Build the dashboard header with avatar, notification and search icons
tickets.description: The dashboard header shows the profile avatar, the notification icon and the search icon. UI only, no behaviour yet.
acceptance_criteria: The header shows the profile image (avatar).
The header shows the notification icon.
The header shows the search icon.

tickets.title: Build the sidebar with logo, navigation items and active state
tickets.description: The sidebar shows the logo at the top and the menu navigation items, with an active state on the current item. Most items navigate to a placeholder page.
acceptance_criteria: The logo is shown at the top of the sidebar.
The sidebar lists the menu navigation items, which navigate to placeholder pages.
The current item shows its active state.

tickets.title: Add the view icons, plus icon and task columns to the main content
tickets.description: The main content shows the list and grid view icons, the plus icon, and the five task columns: backlog, todo, in process, done, cancelled.
acceptance_criteria: The list and grid view icons are shown without functionality.
The plus icon is shown.
The backlog, todo, in process, done and cancelled columns are shown.

tickets.title: Build the task card
tickets.description: Each task card sits in the column that matches its status and shows the task's name, tags, due date, estimated points, user avatar and the options icon.
acceptance_criteria: The card shows the task name.
The card shows the task tags.
The card shows the due date.
The card shows the estimated points.
The card shows the user avatar, with a placeholder image when none is provided.
The card shows the options icon (3 dots) in the top right corner.

tickets.title: Load tasks into the board columns with the tasks query
tickets.description: The board pulls all tasks with the tasks query and places each in its column, with loading, failure and empty states.
acceptance_criteria: The tasks query fills the columns by status.
A loading indicator shows while fetching.
A failed query is indicated to the user.
An empty state shows when there are no results.

tickets.title: Create a task from the plus icon modal
tickets.description: Clicking the red plus icon opens a create task modal that adds the task with the createTask mutation and handles failures.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking the red + icon opens the create task modal.
Submitting the modal runs the createTask mutation and the new task appears in the dashboard.
A failed createTask mutation shows an error.

tickets.title: Edit a task from the card options menu with updateTask
tickets.description: The card's options menu opens a modal with every editable field; confirming runs the updateTask mutation and a notification reports the result.
acceptance_criteria: The updateTask mutation saves the edited card information.
The modal edits due date, name, position, status, tags and estimated time.
The modal shows all the editable fields.
Confirm and cancel buttons confirm or cancel the edit.
A notification shows whether the request succeeded or failed.

tickets.title: Delete a task from the card options menu with deleteTask
tickets.description: The card's options menu deletes a task by id with the deleteTask mutation, after a confirmation, and reports the result.
acceptance_criteria: The deleteTask mutation deletes the task by id.
A confirmation message with confirm and delete buttons shows before deleting.
A notification shows whether the request succeeded or failed.

tickets.title: Filter tasks by name, due date, owner, status, tags and points
tickets.description: Send the tasks query's optional filters in the request and show an empty results component when a filter combination returns nothing.
acceptance_criteria: The request sends the name, due date, owner id, status, tags and estimated points filters when set.
An empty results component shows when the filters return no information.

tickets.title: Show the user information on a settings route
tickets.description: A new settings route shows the user's information from the profile query, in a design that matches the rest of the app.
acceptance_criteria: The settings route shows full name, email, type, position, created at and updated at.

tickets.title: Write the repository README
tickets.description: The README covers setup and running instructions, a project description, screenshots, the rationale for decisions, the libraries used and any additional information.
acceptance_criteria: The README has clear setup and running instructions.
The README has a project description.
The README has gifs or screenshots of the working application.
The README gives the rationale for the stack and project structure.
The README lists the technologies and libraries used.

tickets.title: Show the task count per column and color due dates by delay
tickets.description: Two bonus items: each column shows its total task count, and the due date turns green, yellow or red by how close or late it is.
acceptance_criteria: Each column shows the total count of tasks.
The due date is green when on time, yellow with less than 2 days left, and red when older than the current date.
